Do not adopt the three-quarter camera or redesign geometry from the appearance reference. Do not add people or a scene.
Paint rust-brown and dark grey salvaged steel girders and sheets, faded red-brown tarp, and a warm lantern where present in the guide. Surface patina and material colours match the approved reference. Steel must read as steel, not wood. Preserve the guide's existing structure exactly; material details must not alter geometry or openings.
LIGHTING: this is a TEXTURE SOURCE (albedo). Even, flat, shadowless light from the viewer; no cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light, no background, no floor. Glowing parts are painted at their glowing colour, not as light cast on their surroundings. No theatrical orange lighting from the appearance references.
Only the painted LEFT view, no labels, no text, no comparison panels. Preserve the exact guide alpha silhouette and framing.
